entities.summary: Jesse Winker is an American professional baseball outfielder and designated hitter who is a free agent. He has previously played in Major League Baseball (MLB) for the Cincinnati Reds, Seattle Mariners, Milwaukee Brewers, Washington Nationals, and New York Mets. He made his MLB debut in 2017 and was an All-Star in 2021.
